editorIntro: July sits in the quieter stretch of Peninsula winter, and that is the point. The lead booking is a truffle hunt at Red Hill. Sunday is for the sculpture park at Pt. Leo.

picks.editorVerdict: Peak Périgord black truffle season. The guided hunt-plus-lunch at Red Hill Estate puts you in the grove with a trained dog, and at a table afterwards. The most considered way to spend a cold Peninsula morning. Saturday spots fill - book before you head down.

Sixteen and a half acres, sixty-plus contemporary works, two walking loops through a Merricks winery. No booking required. Walk the outer loop first, then slow down for the inner. It rewards a slow pace rather than a ticked list.

MPRG's winter season is open with Helen Britton and Natalia Milosz-Piekarska among the new exhibitions. Central Mornington, free entry, good coffee close. A grey Saturday morning here is a reasonable plan in its own right.

Flinders Truffles runs farmgate days without a booking - truffle soup and a toastie by the fire. A lower-key version of the seasonal ritual on the southern end of the Peninsula. Check the schedule before heading out.
